programs.name: Post Graduate Diploma in Management - Business Management (PGDM-BM)
programs.feeNote: Admission Prospectus 2027 states programme fees and other charges for the 2-year PGDM(BM)/PGDM(HRM) will be approximately Rs 15.3 lakh per annum (total shown = 2 x 15.3 lakh, approximate); subject to revision and communicated before admission.
programs.intakeNote: Programme seats not stated in Admission Prospectus 2027; XLRI's own NIRF data/mandatory disclosure could not be retrieved.
programs.placementNote: Official prospectus confirms 145 recruiting organisations (25 first-time) in final placements for 2024-26 BM+HRM batch (Jamshedpur + Delhi-NCR) and 42.5% PPOs, but gives no salary figures. XLRI's placement-report page is rendered client-side and its figures could not be read from an official URL, so median/average left null.

programs.name: Post Graduate Diploma in Management - Human Resource Management (PGDM-HRM)
programs.feeNote: Same as PGDM(BM): approximately Rs 15.3 lakh per annum per Admission Prospectus 2027; subject to revision.
programs.placementNote: Combined BM+HRM final placement; no official salary figure readable (see PGDM-BM note).

selectionProcess.name: Shortlisting for interview on XAT 2027 score
selectionProcess.detail: Shortlist for interview in BM & HRM programmes is based only on XAT scores. NRI/Foreign national/PIO/OCI candidates may apply through GMAT.

selectionProcess.name: Personal interview and/or group discussion; final selection
selectionProcess.detail: Final list considers XAT performance, academic background, relevant work experience, performance in personal interview and/or group discussion, extracurricular activities and other relevant criteria. Weights not published in prospectus.

keyDates.notes: XAT 2027 online on 3 Jan 2027; last date for online registration of XAT-XLRI programmes 6 Dec 2026. XAT fee Rs 2,300 + Rs 200 per XLRI programme. Final exams must be completed by 11 June 2027; orientation June 2027.

sources.title: XLRI Admission Prospectus 2027 (linked as 'Admission Prospectus' from xlri.ac.in)
sources.supports: fee (approx 15.3 lakh p.a.) 2027-29; exams; specialisations; selection process; XAT 2027 dates; 2024-26 recruiter count
